items.title: 4.3.3 Combining Queue and Graph to Perform BFS (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of BFS with a queue (PDF 120-121).

blocks.text: Breadth-First Search (BFS) bhi graph ya tree ko explore karne ka basic (bunyadi) algorithm hai. DFS ke ulat, BFS dekhne wale nodes ko queue mein rakhta hai. Yeh tab useful (faidemand) hai jab agle level par jane se pehle current (abhi wale) level ke saare nodes dekhne hon, maslan sab se chhota raasta dhoondna ho ya level ba level saare raaste dekhne hon.
Misal: wohi Figure 4.13 wala tree lein (4.3.2 mein).
BFS queue ki madad se is graph ko aise traverse karta hai (queue ko [aage ... peeche] likha gaya hai):

items: Khali queue se shuru kar ke root node (1) enqueue karein.
Qadam 1: node 1 dequeue kar ke visited mark karein, us ke children 2, 3, 4 enqueue karein. Queue: [2, 3, 4].
Qadam 2: aage wala node 2 dequeue karein, visited mark karein, us ke children 5, 6 enqueue karein. Queue: [3, 4, 5, 6].
Qadam 3: node 3 dequeue karein, visited mark karein, us ka child 7 enqueue karein. Queue: [4, 5, 6, 7].
Qadam 4: node 4 dequeue karein, visited mark karein, children 8, 9 enqueue karein. Queue: [5, 6, 7, 8, 9].
Qadam 5: node 5 dequeue karein, visited mark karein; children nahi. Queue: [6, 7, 8, 9].
Qadam 6: node 6 dequeue karein; children nahi. Queue: [7, 8, 9].
Qadam 7: node 7 dequeue karein; children nahi. Queue: [8, 9].
Qadam 8: node 8 dequeue karein; children nahi. Queue: [9].
Qadam 9: node 9 dequeue karein; children nahi. Ab queue khali hai.

blocks.text: Is misal mein BFS ka order: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9. Queue ki wajah se agle level par jane se pehle current level ke saare nodes dekhe jate hain. Yeh tareeqa unweighted (bina weight wale) graphs mein sab se chhota raasta dhoondne ya har level ke saare connections dekhne ke liye khaas taur par achha hai.

blocks.prompt: DFS aur BFS mein farq bataiye (short question 8). Long question 7(b): exercise ke graph mein A se BFS ka order kya hai?
blocks.explanation: DFS stack (ya recursion) istemal karta hai aur wapas aane se pehle ek shaakh mein gehrai tak jata hai. BFS queue istemal karta hai aur agle level se pehle ek level ke saare nodes dekhta hai; unweighted graphs mein sab se chhota raasta isi se milta hai. Exercise ke graph mein A se BFS: A, B, C, D, E, F, G, H, I.

items: 9 nodes wale tree par queue wala BFS: 1 se 9 tak order se.
DFS gehra jata hai (stack), BFS chaura (queue).
